mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the forerunner of neo functionalism.

Realism is a doctrine that responds to the fact of a changing political reality. • The ethics of international relations is a political or situational ethics which is very different from private morality.

fib: ______ are the great thinkers of old who chose a middle course between idealism and realism.
The ancestors of functionalism are the great thinkers of old who chose a middle course between idealism and realism.

International politics is an arena of conflicting state interests.

Carr is known for his vociferous attack on idealism as a hopeless dream that could never achieve anything practical (Haslam 1999).

Politics is the arena for the expression of those interests which are bound to come into conflict sooner or later.
